title: O Word of Truth! in Devious Paths
description: O Word of Truth! in Devious Paths in Tonic Solfa to WINCHESTER OLD, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns of the Greek Church (Edinburgh and London, 1900), headed “An Evening Hymn”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Common Metre (8.6.8.6), and this page sets them to WINCHESTER OLD; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O Word of Truth! in de-vious paths My way-ward feet have trod, I have not kept the day se-rene I gave at morn to God.

lines: O Word of Truth! in devious paths
I have not kept the day serene
I gave at morn to God.
And now 'tis night, and night within,
O God, the light hath fled!
I have not kept the vow I made
For clouds of gloom from nether world
O Christ the Light, Thy light bestow
And turn my night to day!

source: John Brownlie, Hymns of the Greek Church (1900)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns of the Greek Church; set to WINCHESTER OLD by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
